findings.current_text: पोस्ट छोड़ दी / DM छोड़ दिया
findings.proposed_text: दोबारा पोस्ट नहीं किया / दोबारा DM नहीं भेजा
findings.reason: «DM/संदेश छोड़ना» is the 'leave a message' idiom, so the row can read as SENT; «पोस्ट छोड़ दी» is ambiguous (gave up / left a post). 'Did not post/send again' states a deliberate non-send, distinct from failed «नहीं कर सका».
findings.disposition: fixed in this audit's commit (retranslated by i18n-translator c9f77e05a801)

findings.proposed_text: (code) a {target}-bearing template, e.g. «Maya को दोबारा DM नहीं भेजा»
findings.reason: Measured: the row composes f'{verb} {target}', so hi renders verb BEFORE target — contrary to the PR body's claim. Same as audited «DM भेजा Maya». Natural SOV order needs a templated key, a code change.

limitations: LLM linguistic audit, not a native-speaker attestation.
No terminal bidi/shaping or rendered-frame claim.
